provider: Louisiana Title Statistical Services Organization, Inc. (LATISSO) — rating bureau manual, all member insurers
asOf: (06/01/2026) Edition — effective to orders received on or after June 1, 2026; filed with the Louisiana Department of Insurance (LIRC# Form Filing DEMT-134801757, Rate/Rule Filing DEMT-134802798)

settlementFee.note: Title insurance premium (and Closing Protection Coverage) only, NOT an escrow/settlement-service fee schedule. GP-3 explicitly excludes title search, examination, closing, and escrow charges from the rate.
settlementFee.homeownersPolicy: 110% of the Owner's Policy premium under PR-1, plus any endorsement premiums (Rule PR-1.1). One-to-four family residential or individual condominium unit only.
settlementFee.expandedCoverageResidentialLoanPolicy: 110% of the Loan Policy premium under PR-2, plus any endorsement premiums (Rule PR-2.1).
settlementFee.simultaneousIssueLoanPolicy: Flat $100 per Loan Policy issued concurrently with an Owner's Policy (or $125 for an Expanded Loan Policy), provided the loan liability does not exceed the owner's policy liability; minimum premium $100 (Rule PR-4).
settlementFee.reissueCredit_ownersPolicy: 60% credit against the Original Rate up to the amount of insurance of an existing Owner's Policy issued within 10 prior years, minimum premium $100 (Rule PR-4.3).
settlementFee.substitutionCredit_loanPolicy: 60% credit against the Original Rate up to the unpaid principal balance of an existing loan policy, minimum premium $100 (Rule PR-4.2).
settlementFee.residentialLimitedCoverageMortgageModifi: $0.50 per thousand of the unpaid mortgage balance, minimum premium $125 (Rule PR-5).

itemizedFees.cpl: $25 per transaction, flat, regardless of party (Section 3, 'Rate applicable to closing services insurance, on a per transaction basis is $25')

bundlingNotes: GP-3: 'The rates set forth herein do not include any charge made for title search, title examination, closing, or escrow services performed by the Insurer or any of its attorneys or agents. Similarly, corporate operating expenses and pre-tax profit provisions are excluded. Charges made for such services are in addition to the rates and charges set forth herein.' GP-4 further disclaims that the manual provides no indemnification against improper acts by a person performing escrow or settlement services. A municipal/local premium tax may also apply per parish (referenced in a companion WFG bulletin pattern seen in other states, not itself priced in this manual). LATISSO is Louisiana's private rating bureau under RS 22:1467/RS 22:1409.1 -- membership is voluntary but any properly licensed insurer cannot be denied membership, making this manual materially closer to a single-source-of-truth for the whole market's title premiums than a typical single-underwriter filing, analogous to NCTIRB (NC) or OTIRB (OH).
transactionContext: Statewide (no parish/metro breakout in the base rate tables; only the separately-published municipal premium tax schedule varies by parish). Owner's, Leasehold Owner's, Homeowner's, and Loan policies (original, simultaneous issue, reissue/substitution credits, mechanics'/materialmen's lien protection), Closing Protection Coverage, and a full schedule of ALTA/LATISSO endorsement rates (109 distinct endorsements priced). No purchase/refinance settlement-service-fee breakdown anywhere in the manual.

provider: WFG National Title Insurance Company — Seller Net Sheet Rate Calculator (rates.wfgnationaltitle.com)
scenario: $500,000 purchase price, $400,000 loan amount, East Baton Rouge County (LA's most-populous/standard-scenario county), residential resale (SettlementStatementVersion: CD).
methodology: Solved this session by extracting the calculator's own Angular "sellerNetForm" component logic from its lazy-loaded route chunk (webpack chunk 7, hash 8a01902021d264bdb338 -- fetched by replaying the runtime bundle's own chunk-hash map, since this route is not referenced in the shell page's main.js until a user actually clicks into the seller-net-sheet flow). This resolved the 2026-08-07 session's blocker: `POST /api/rates/fees/estimatefeesforsellernet` was 500ing with unhelpful ProblemDetails errors because the guessed flat `PropertyState`/`PropertyCounty`/`PropertyCity` fields (borrowed from the sibling, differently-shaped `sellernet/calculate` endpoint's own validation-error field names) do not match this endpoint's real schema. The component's own `prepareCalculateFeeRequest()` method reveals the actual required body: `Properties: [{City, County, IsPrimary: true, State}]` (nested, not flat), `Loans: [{LienPosition: 0, LoanAmount}]`, `TransactionProductType: {ProductTypeId: 0, TransactionTypeId: 0}` (0/0 confirmed correct for this flow, not a placeholder), `calculateTaxRequest: {}` (an empty class instance), `SettlementStatementVersion: "CD"`, and empty arrays/objects for `premiumDiscounts`/`Endorsements`/`PriorLenderPolicy`/`PriorOwnerPolicy`. Driven via a plain Content-Type: application/json HTTP POST, no browser/JS execution needed. Confirmed via `GET /api/rates/State/GetCalculationEnabledStates` (also public, no auth) that this one API has `isCalculationEnabled: true` for 47 states + DC -- a single new, genuinely distinct 5th major-underwriter source (WFG National Title, a separate corporate family from FNF/Old Republic/Stewart/First American, all already on file elsewhere in this survey) usable across nearly every remaining below-threshold scarce state in one technique. No personal-data field (name/email/phone) exists anywhere in this request shape. Separately confirmed via static inspection of the same chunk's hardcoded `feesConfiguration` sort-weight table that WFG has only itemized its settlement/closing HUD-fee line items for 7 states (WA, CA, TX, OR, AZ, NV, CO) -- for every other state (including this one) the tool returns a premium-only result (Owner's Title Insurance Premium, no settlement/search/doc-prep breakdown), which per this project's 2026-08-05 FNF scoping correction is still valid, dated calculator-harvest evidence.

provider: Stewart Title Guaranty Company -- Stewart Rate Calculator, matched settlement office: BD Title, LLC (450 Laurel St, 21st Floor, Chase North Tower, Baton Rouge, LA 70801)
calculatorUrl: https://www.stewartratecalculator.com/Quote/LoanEstimate?urlParams=&quotetype=3&branded=true (LoanEstimate/QuoteType=3 flow) and https://www.stewartratecalculator.com/Quote/Netsheet?urlParams=&quotetype=2&branded=true (Netsheet/QuoteType=2 flow); both POST to the shared /api/SRC/quote endpoint
scenario: $500,000 purchase price, $400,000 loan amount, East Baton Rouge County (Baton Rouge), residential resale, Sale/Purchase with Mortgage transaction type, BASIC coverage on both Owner's and Lender's policies. Richness-pass harvest applying an already-solved, previously state-limited recipe to a state not yet in Stewart's harvested-state list, per the standing 'check tracker coverage before hunting a new platform' recommendation (CALCULATORS.md, 2026-08-19 session).
methodology: Harvested via Stewart's discoverable `/api/SRC/*` JSON REST API (stewartratecalculator.com), driven entirely by plain HTTP GET/POST (Python requests.Session(), cookie jar) with no browser/JS execution and no personal-data fields, replaying the full recipe documented in this project's CALCULATORS.md (2026-08-14 'SOLVED' entry): GET the LoanEstimate/Netsheet page to scrape a fresh antiforgery cookie + __RequestVerificationToken; GET /api/SRC/propertysearch to resolve the county FIPS code and a default zip; GET /api/SRC/providers to find the county's real settlement office(s) (used to set ProviderID on the QuoteType=3 flow so the itemized settlement-fee list is populated -- an empty ProviderID silently returns a null itemized list); GET /api/SRC/statesettings and /api/SRC/ernstlookup for state-level defaults; build the QuoteRequestRoot JSON by hand (Owner's Policy $500,000 / Lender's Policy $400,000, BASIC coverage, standard Sale/Purchase with Mortgage transaction); POST /api/SRC/quote twice -- QuoteType=2 (Netsheet, pageBuyerSeller=seller) for Recording/CFPB2015 transfer-tax figures, and QuoteType=3 (LoanEstimate, pageBuyerSeller=buyer, IsCalculatePremium=True, IsCalculateTitleServiceFee=True) for the itemized Pricing.TitleServiceFee.ItemizedTitleServiceFeeList settlement-fee line items. One new gotcha found and fixed this session: stewartratecalculator.com's bare apex domain 301-redirects every POST to the www subdomain, and that redirect's response body hangs indefinitely on this sandbox's proxied connection (a 30s+ read timeout with 0 bytes received) -- fixed by targeting https://www.stewartratecalculator.com directly, skipping the apex redirect entirely; this is an environment/proxy artifact, not a sign the endpoint is blocked. Also confirmed the documented /api/SRC/providers gotcha firsthand: for a single-provider county the response's `Provider` field is a bare object, not a one-element list -- must be normalized before indexing or ProviderID silently stays empty and every itemized-fee list comes back null (looks exactly like a genuine empty result).
